# hooks

install.ts orchestrates git-lanes hook installation for AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Aider).

## Contents

- [install.ts](./install.ts) exports `installHooks`, `uninstallHooks` to manage adapter-specific configurations via `ADAPTERS` registry.

## API Surface

`installHooks(adapter?: string, cwd?: string): void` creates hooks directory, writes bash hook scripts with mode 0o755, merges config files via `deepMerge`, writes `.claude/rules/git-lanes.md` workflow rules. `uninstallHooks(adapter?: string, cwd?: string): void` removes hook files for specified adapter, preserves config files.

## Adapter Configurations

`ADAPTERS` registry maps adapter names to config functions: `claude-code` → `getClaudeCodeConfig`, `cursor` → `getCursorConfig`, `aider` → `getAiderConfig`. Unknown adapters throw `Error` listing available keys. `getClaudeCodeConfig(): AdapterConfig` creates `.claude/hooks/` with three scripts: `git-lanes-pre-tool` (PreToolUse hook checking session via `git lanes which` before Write/Edit/MultiEdit), `git-lanes-post-tool` (PostToolUse tracking files via `git lanes track`), `git-lanes-stop` (Stop hook auto-committing WIP). `getCursorConfig(): AdapterConfig` creates `.cursor/hooks/git-lanes-pre-save` tracking file saves. `getAiderConfig(): AdapterConfig` creates `.aider/hooks/git-lanes-pre-edit` warning if no session active.

## Workflow Rules

`getAgentRules(): string` returns markdown rules enforced at `.claude/rules/git-lanes.md`: start sessions with `git lanes start <descriptive-name>`, use descriptive names (e.g., `fix-auth-bug`), commit frequently, check conflicts, never end others' sessions, run tests before ending, end with `git lanes end -m "message"`.

## Dependencies

`install.ts` imports `getRepoRoot` from `../git.ts`, `log` from `../utils/logger.ts`. Native `fs` functions: `existsSync`, `mkdirSync`, `writeFileSync`, `unlinkSync`, `readFileSync`.
